user.title: Connect balenaCloud Fleet
user.description: Use a balenaCloud API key and fleet ID. Optionally enter one LAN address per device as UUID=http://address:port, one per line, for local playback polling and reboot/restart actions.

data.local_device_urls: Local device URLs (optional; UUID=http://address:port per line)

error.cannot_connect: Could not authenticate or read this fleet. Check the API key and fleet ID.
